title: Orders, costing and money records for tailors
course_title: Fashion Business Management: Running a Profitable Tailoring Business

say: Orders, costing and money records for tailors.
This is the video for module 2 of Fashion Business Management.
Late outfits, lost measurements and arguments over balances usually come from the same root: no fixed process.

items: Late outfits and balance fights have one root

say: Promise dates from your capacity, not from hope. For example, Funmi sews about 30 hours a week in her Ibadan shop. A client wants a lined gown by Saturday of next week.

Offer: two weeks, or express with paid help

say: Now costing. First find your overhead rate. Zainab's running costs are about 100,000 naira a month, and she sews about 200 hours, so overheads are 500 naira an hour.
Her materials are fabric at about 15,000 naira, lining at 3,000 and trims at 2,000. That is 20,000 naira.
The gown takes 8 hours. Labour at 1,000 naira an hour is 8,000, and overheads at 500 an hour are 4,000.
Total cost is 32,000 naira. This is her floor price. Anything below it loses money.
For a 25% margin she divides by 0.75, and rounds to 43,000 naira.
With a full package, Zainab supplies everything, so the price must cover all the materials.
With a sewing fee, she supplies only the trims. Her cost is about 14,000, so she charges about 19,000.
If the shop next door charges 12,000, she cannot match it without losing money. She competes on fit and finish instead.
If a client wants a lower price, change the order, not your margin: a simpler style, or no lining.
Open a separate account for the business. Your bank statement then becomes a second record of business money.

panel.heading: Three habits that protect your cash

cards.d: Clients pay deposits and balances into a business account used only for the shop.
If a client disappears, you have not lost money. Apply the rule to everyone.
Pay yourself a set amount each week or month, recorded as Owner's wage.

say: Set your deposit so that, if a client disappears, you have lost nothing. You cannot resell fabric cut to one person's size. Apply this to friends and church members too.

say: Some fraudsters send fake credit alerts or edited screenshots, then rush to collect a garment.
Confirm the money has arrived in your banking app or bank statement before you release anything. And never share your PIN, password or one-time code with anyone.

panel.heading: Before you release any garment
items: Payment checked in your banking app
Never trust an SMS alert or screenshot
Never share your PIN, password or OTP
Receipt given showing the balance

say: To remember. Use the same stages for every order. Promise only what your hours allow. Cost every style and never quote below cost. And keep your cash book every day.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Same six stages and a record for every order
Promise dates from your weekly capacity
Price = total cost divided by 1 minus margin
Total cost is your floor price
Write every naira in and out the same day
